requirements: Reconcile the claimed round-2 Linux worker and executor before overlapping work, and verify exact branch head and contributor ancestry.

Run :solr:core:cleanTest :solr:core:test --tests org.apache.solr.update.SolrCmdDistributorTest with a recorded seed. Require all named r9 regression tests to execute without skips; repeat the network and concurrency cases with multiple seeds. Explicitly prove the HTTP/1.1 fixture reaches and asserts both 200 and intended-node 503 callbacks. Run tidy and root check -x test; report any formatting changes and require a successor head and gate if needed.

Carry forward and verify the r9 gate's test and proof requirements: exact stall IOException, real retry delivery, JavaBin RF accounting, controlled drain mutation, unchanged-test executable fail-before overlays for retry classification, blocked-body fencing, client-monitor callbacks, lost errors and ordered operations. The r9 receipt has a valid drain mutation on a compile-fixed proof tree; assess applicability and repeat if necessary. Compile failures, skips, setup errors and unrelated timeouts are not behavioral proof.

Separately exercise actual concurrent blockUntilFinished with real success and failed network callbacks. Assess multiple stalled clients, late callbacks, RF and error attribution, queued writes after stall and replica recovery; active runners are fenced but not cancelled. Do not give a clean verdict with unresolved material concerns. No source edits or public comments; fixes require a successor gate.
verdict_policy: Pass requires all positive checks and discriminating proof legs, no skips, and no unresolved material concern.
